records.text: Arizona politicians Eddie and David Farnsworth are brothers and first cousins of Terryl Farnsworth's father, Dwayne Farnsworth.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Terryl (Terryl Farnsworth)'s father is a man named Dwayne Farnsworth. And his first cousins are longtime Arizona congressman Eddie Farnsworth. I believe he left office in 2022. And also his brother, Eddie (Eddie Farnsworth)'s brother is David Farnsworth.

verification.notes: Public biographical sources support that Eddie and David Farnsworth are brothers, but no authoritative public record was found proving the asserted first-cousin relationship to Dwayne Farnsworth.

records.text: In 2014, Arizona senator David Farnsworth introduced Lori Frantzve, then CEO of GTEC Industries, during legislative consideration of an electromagnetic-pulse bill that Eddie Farnsworth voted on.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: in 2014, Senator David Farnsworth. introduced Erika (Erika Kirk)'s mother to the house floor with concerns over EMPs, okay? At the time, David Farnsworth was actually sponsoring the bill, a bill which would involve introducing Lori (Lori Frantzve), who was then the CEO of GTEC Industries. And Eddie Farnsworth is also listed as having voted on this particular bill.

verification.notes: Official March 19, 2014 Arizona House committee minutes identify David Farnsworth as SB1476's sponsor, record his introduction of Lori Frantzve as GTEC Industries CEO, show Eddie Farnsworth present, and record a 7-0 do-pass vote.

sources.title: Arizona House Committee on Public Safety, Military and Regulatory Affairs Minutes — March 19, 2014
sources.relevance: Official minutes identify David Farnsworth as sponsor, Lori Frantzve as GTEC CEO and presenter, and Eddie Farnsworth as present for the committee vote.

records.text: Lori Frantzve appeared on the Arizona legislative floor in support of an electromagnetic-pulse preparedness measure sponsored by David Farnsworth and promoted recommendations associated with GTEC Industries.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: On the on the congressional floor, because she is she has David Farnsworth sponsoring a bill, she's doing this panic stuff, there could be an EMP event, and we have to get prepared for an EMP event that could happen electromagnetic pulses and here is what me and my husband Larry Guinta recommend that you do.

verification.notes: Arizona Legislature committee minutes confirm Lori Frantzve, identified as CEO of GTEC Industries, appeared with sponsor Senator David Farnsworth to support SB1476 on EMP preparedness and participated in a presentation. The episode's description of the appearance as on the legislative floor is imprecise; the record is a House committee hearing.

sources.title: Arizona Legislature committee minutes for SB1476
sources.relevance: Official minutes name Lori Frantzve, GTEC Industries, David Farnsworth, and the EMP presentation.

records.text: Candace Owens says Tyler Bowyer met Charlie Kirk in 2014 while Bowyer chaired the Maricopa County Republican Committee, where Eddie and David Farnsworth also served.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: and crucially the Bowyers the Farnsworths the Frantzves the Kolvets they're all just vibing around each other at all times and what happens crucially is that Tyler Bowyer is going to meet Charlie Kirk this year It is still not clear to me how they met, but we can state that Tyler (Tyler Bowyer) is the chairman at that time of the Maricopa County Republican Committee and Eddie Farnsworth is on that committee and David Farnsworth is on that committee.

verification.notes: Current reporting confirms Tyler Bowyer met Charlie Kirk in 2014 while Bowyer chaired the Maricopa County Republican Committee. Searches did not locate a reliable contemporaneous roster proving both Eddie and David Farnsworth served on that same committee at that time, so the composite statement is only partly established.

sources.title: KTAR - Tyler Bowyer remembers Charlie Kirk
sources.relevance: Confirms the 2014 meeting and Bowyer's MCRC chairmanship.
